templates.title: Prunerr
templates.name: prunerr
templates.description: Media library cleanup for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. Build rules over watch history, age, size, rating and quality, preview what they match, and review every deletion in a queue before it happens. Removes through Sonarr and Radarr.
templates.note: Open the Web UI on port 3000 and pick your media server, then connect Sonarr and Radarr under Settings — no environment variables are required, everything is configured in the app. The /app/data volume holds the SQLite database and all configuration; swap it for a bind mount if you would rather keep it on a known host path. Set PUID/PGID to the user that should own those files.

env.name: PUID
env.label: PUID
env.description: User ID that owns the data directory.

env.name: PGID
env.label: PGID
env.description: Group ID that owns the data directory.

env.name: TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: Used for scan schedules and log timestamps, e.g. Europe/London.
